source_title: Metro 2033 Redux - Blogger Achievement Guide (All Diary Pages) - GameRant
source_excerpt:
For those who love to complete all achievements in games, Metro 2033 Redux has a difficult and missable achievement to earn that requires two different playthroughs. There are 51 diary pages for you to collect if you want the Blogger achievement, and we've got their locations below so you know when and where you can get them, so you don't miss a thing!
You can use the chapter selection menu if you've missed any of the collectibles shown below.
In the opening scene, after climbing up the ladder, enter the next room, turn left, and pick up the diary from the shelf.
After you wake up in your room in the bunker and head out to see the Hunter, you reach a part where the man you are following knocks on a door and waits for a soldier to open it.
After you enter, you will be in a hospital-like room. On your right, there is a desk with a diary page on it.
This diary will appear in your personal room. The next time you wake up in your room, check the tiny chair on the right, near the door, and you will find a diary page on it.
While on the same mission, you will exit your room and follow the arrow signs to reach a gunsmith to receive your weapons and equipment.
After you exit the gunsmith room, turn left, go through the door, exit the other door, then turn left again into a room with three people hanging out next to a bonfire.
Now, turn right, and you should spot a red door ahead. Open it and get inside. On the right, you will find a diary page on top of a wooden drawer.
After you go through the tunnels and reach Riga, you will be drinking with your friends at a bar. When you stand up to leave, there is a diary page on the bar's counter.
After you pick up the diary page from the bar, exit the bar by going downstairs, then turn left. Reach the end of the hallway and turn right. You will find the next diary page sitting on a bench against the wall.
The last diary page in Riga station is in the same restaurant room where you will meet Bourbon. After picking up the last diary page, return to the bar's staircase and, this time, follow the path to the right.
Go through the door and turn left immediately. Follow the narrow path to the end and then use the stairs on your left to return.
Turn left from the second bridge as you return. Inside the restaurant, you will find the diary page on the table behind Bourbon.
On the next mission, you will accompany Bourbon in the dark tunnels to the Market. At one point, you will reach a wide tunnel with lots of enemies.
After you deal with them, follow Bourbon to a narrow corridor, where you will kill a few more enemies, until you reach a red door. Bourbon will open the door.
As you enter the next room, look to your left, and you should spot the diary page on the electrical box.
At the end of your journey with Bourbon, you find a big door that leads to Market, but before approaching the door, there is a ladder on your left that goes down.
Drop down the ladder and continue towards the broken staircase on the other side. Next to the staircase, there is a concrete pillar with a dead body at its foot. The diary page is located next to the corpse.
When the market door is open, there is a wooden ammo box behind the machine gunner, under the map. You can find the next diary page on the box.
After entering the market, pass by the blue train and turn left at the end of the corridor. Then, turn right and move directly ahead.
Go through the small door, and you will enter a trading area. Exit the other end of the room towards the parked vehicle.
On the opposite side of the vehicle, there is a small counter next to the fenced room. You can pick up the next diary page from the counter.
After leaving the Market, you enter Dead City. You start in a metro station, and that's where the diary page is located.
As soon as the mission begins. Turn left, and you should spot an open door on the left corner of the station.
There is a wire trap on the door. So, make sure to disarm it first. Go upstairs, and follow the corridor all the way to its end. There is another wire trap on the way. Open the blue door and get inside. You will find the diary page next to the safe.
Exit the metro station at the Dead City and follow the mission until you reach a store. After exiting the store, turn left. Follow the path straight ahead until you spot a blue street sign.
Make a U-turn and go on top of the rubble. You will pass through two doors until you find a blue door inside a room. Open it, and turn into the second room on your right. The next diary page is sitting on a desk.
Near the end of your journey in the Dead City, you will find Bourbon under a tall tunnel-like gate. After that, move towards the opposite side of the gate. Pass by two trash cans and turn right at the end of the path.
Then, before reaching a staircase that heads down, turn left, and you will find an open door with white graffiti next to it. As soon as you enter the apartment, you can find the diary page on your right on a table.
When the Dry mission begins, you are inside a sewer canal. Wait for the cinematic to wrap up, then exit the canal and turn left. Immediately after that, turn left again, through the door with iron bars. You will find the diary page on a weapon box.
Continue the Dry mission . You will have to either kill a lot of bandits or sneak behind them until you reach the room where Bourbon is being kept. Inside that room, you will find a diary page on a table with a big engine on it.
Follow Khan in the Ghosts mission until you reach a blue train wagon in the tunnels. Get inside the wagon and look at the benches on your right, where a diary page is located.
While you are in the Ghosts tunnel, a train of ghosts will pass by. After that, continue the path with Khan and look at the ground on the right side of the tunnel. The first corpse that you spot will have a diary page next to it.
Near the end of the Ghosts tunnel, you reach a point where a big horde of monsters attack, but the anomaly kills them all.
After that, hop on the train behind and exit its side door. Before you reach the trolley with Khan, there is a small suitcase on the left side of the railway, with a diary page inside.
When you reach the Cursed station and talk to some of the survivors there, head to the other end of the station and look for an upward staircase on your right.
On top of the stairs, you will find a dead body beyond the pillars, where a diary page is located next to it.
When Andrew takes you to his room in the Armory, you can spot a diary page just next to him on the shelf.
Exit Andrew's room and turn left. Then, follow the path ahead directly until you reach a trolley with a well in front of it. Drop inside the well, and you will find a diary page.
When the Front Line mission begins, you will have to fight a massive number of Nazis through the tunnels until you reach a dead end with a door on your left leading to a new room.
Inside this room, you will find a watertight door, but don't open it. Turn left before reaching the door, and you will spot a desk at the corner of the room with a diary page on it.
In the Trolley Combat mission, after getting off the trolley, you will enter a narrow corridor. Turn right at the end, and you will find the diary page on top of a drawer on your left.
In the Depot mission, you will spot a train wagon on the railway. You need to move from the right side of the railway to reach the final wagon and enter the train.
Now, you should come all the way back to the first wagon from inside, and you will find a diary page on the wagon's floor near the exit door.
After a long fight at the roadblock in the Defense mission, go through the fenced doors and take the path to the left, go through another iron door, and you should spot a wooden ramp ahead.
Go up, make a U-turn, and you should find the diary page on a bed.
There is another diary to pick up in the Defense mission, and this one is located in a tricky spot. After collecting the last diary, continue the path towards the station.
After you enter the station, turn left from the first possible entry and then turn right. Move forward until you spot a wooden staircase on your left. After that staircase, turn left immediately.
When you enter the next hallway, turn left once more and move forward until you spot another wooden staircase on your right. Go up, then reach the end of the train's second floor, where you will find a diary page on the floor, next to a dead body.
When you find the boy who has missed his uncle during the Defense mission, there is also a diary page on the ground in the same room.
After the boy hops on your back, look to your left, next to the big gas pipe, and you should find the diary page.
After delivering the boy to his mom, follow the other soldier to the end of the tunnel. When you reach the campsite, there is a trolley on your left, with a diary page on it.
When the Outpost mission begins and you enter the big open area under the surface level, turn right immediately and move towards the corner until you spot a ladder. Go up the ladder, and look at the box on the opposite side, where a diary page is located.
While at the Outpost mission, head to the surface level, take a right, and then a left to go through the broken blocks to the other side.
Now, pass over a bent steel bridge, and climb up on top of the yellow bulldozer ahead. Reach the tip of the bulldozer's nose, and then jump on the ladder on your left. Go to the building's roof and drop down from the left.
Enter the corridor through the door, and then enter the first room on your left to collect the diary page from a desk.
At the beginning of the Black Station quest, turn right and follow the path ahead until you reach a campsite with two enemy soldiers inside. Kill them and grab the diary page from the top of the box in the corner of the room.
In the same Black Station mission, move forward and kill the rest of the Nazi bandits until you reach a spot where there are three tunnels ahead.
Go through the middle tunnel, turn left, and go down the hatch. Move forward along the path, and when you reach an open blue door, turn left instead of passing through the door, and you will find the diary page on the ground.
When you reach the Polis and enter the reception room, look to the right, and you will find the diary page on a shelf.
While in the Polis station, Miller will debrief you about the situation. In the same room, you can collect a diary page sitting on top of a barrel in the corner.
When the Alley mission begins, go forward and exit the station. Now, turn left and move ahead until you spot a corpse on the ground with a diary page next to it.
In the Alley mission, after fighting the hordes of monsters in front of the library, you open the doors and get inside. As soon as you enter the main hall of the library, turn right, and there is a diary page on top of a broken desk.
In the Depository mission, drop down and turn right. You will find a closed door, but you can break it with bullets or melee hits.
Enter the corridor and move towards the far end. Turn left at the end and enter the next room. Here, you will find the diary page on a shelf.
As soon as the Archives mission kicks off, you will spot two librarians ahead. Try to sneak from their left side, and you will spot a single shelf ahead with a diary page on it.
When you arrive at Church in the mission of the same name, get off the vehicle, and there is a barrel just in front of you. That's where the diary page is located.
Head to the second floor of the church in the same mission and make a U-turn on top. You will find the diary page on a box full of books on the ground.
In the Dark Star mission, after killing the monsters with the flamethrower, you get off the trolley at the station. Turn right here and move through the door ahead. Look at the ground, and you will spot the diary page.
In the Cave mission, after opening the first gate with the lever, enter the next room, and at the far corner on the right, you will find a diary page next to a dead body.
The next gate that you open with the lever in the Cave mission turns chaotic, as a monster attacks you. After dealing with the threats, go beyond the gate and look to your left. You will find a diary page on a metal box near the elevator.
Near the end of the Cave mission, you will pass through a gate alone. Then, you will go down a well to finally end up in a narrow tunnel with a wooden floor.
After exiting the tunnel, you will spot a big well ahead. Jump down to the wooden floor, and you will find a diary page next to a dead body.
The D6 mission features 4 diary pages. The first one can be found as soon as the mission begins. While you are on the train, turn back, look to your left, and you will spot a diary page on the bench.
After you activate the motors of the spiral elevator in the D6 mission and move in front of the Sector A1 gate, a yellow vehicle will force open the gate.
Go inside, then wait for the other two doors to open up as well. Head to the control room, and you will find the diary page sitting on the third control desk to your right.
After you split up with the rest of the crew to go deeper in the D6 mission, you will reach a circular corridor with lots of those anomaly-spitting flowers on the path.
When you reach the end of this path, where another elevator is located, don't get on the elevator. Instead, move ahead, and you will spot a yellow vehicle, inside which there is a diary page.
After removing the rods with the crane, come back to your companion, and you will enter a long corridor. At the end of this corridor and before getting on the elevator, you will spot the next diary page on the wall.
In the Tower mission, when you get on top of the elevator and it crashes at the end, as soon as you stand up on your feet, look at the ground; there is a diary page to collect.
The final diary page is located on your path towards the top of the tower. After leaving Miller, you will continue your path towards the top of the tower. At one point, you will enter a room with a watertight door at the other end.
Open the door and head out. Then, turn left and move forward a little while, looking at the ground. The diary page is located next to a skeleton.
If you have collected all the diary pages so far, the Blogger achievement will unlock instantly after grabbing the final diary page.
